text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's orientation day, when the academy
invites
children to tour the campus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute is taking part in an
exhibition race
designed to show the
kids what real racing is all
about.

text_block_list.name: Visiting Children
text_block_list.text:
Are you going to run right now?
I've
never seen a race up close before!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Is that right, dear? In that case, I better
run with
some oomph.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice Wonder Acute's clothes look
oddly loose
when she heads to the track.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Now that you mention it, it does
feel slightly
baggy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She shrugs off my concerns, but I think I
know
what happened here...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In short, I would like you to run in the
exhibition
race.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Sure. No bother at all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...And that's that. Now, I'd better start
honing my
body.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
This is an important event that could
end up
shaping those young lives
forever. I have to run
with everything I
have.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Grrr! And that's... one hundred
reps!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Phew! I worked up quite a sweat! Next
up, a
twenty-kilometer swim in the pool!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Chicken tenderloin, broccoli, and a
boiled egg?!
Don't tell me that's all
you're eating!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right. It's high-protein and
low-calorie. A
staple for building lean
muscle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's been toning her body for today.
However, I
didn't think she'd slim down
so much that her
racewear wouldn't fit
properly...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you needn't worry. Here, have a
look-see...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ruffle, ruffle... Tug!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What did I tell you? Now the waist is a
perfect fit!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I had my signature racewear made
adjustable,
seeing as my weight
fluctuates quite a lot
throughout the
year.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Each race is different after all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Different distances, different types of
tracks... I'm
still developing physically as
well and won't
necessarily always be in
the same condition.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I need to be able to adjust my body to
fit the
circumstances, so I wanted
racewear that can
change with me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You have to set one goal at a time and
stay
focused on it without wavering.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Only by maintaining that focus and
honing your
body to its limit can you
reach that goal.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Especially for an exhibition race, dearie.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You know, it's likely many of the tykes
at this
orientation today dream of
enrolling in Tracen
one day.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I want to show them one way to pursue a
goal.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: That is, honing your mind and body.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Obviously my methods aren't for
everyone, but
seeing me might just give
them a hint to finding
their own.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's why I have to show them the
absolute best
that I can do.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's why I have to show them the
absolute best
that I can do.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well now... I don't know about all that.
I'm only
doing what anyone would.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, an immense growl escapes
Wonder
Acute's stomach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rrrumble...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Dear me... I hope none of the tykes
heard that.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I can't go teaching them that it's okay to
push
yourself too hard. Let's keep this
rumbly tummy
between you and me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute is sincerely concerned for
the kids.
As soon as the exhibition race
is over, I'm going
to treat her to a
wonderful meal.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's very kind of you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But the truth is, I'm just not familiar with
all that
fashion hoopla.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I left the appearance up to the tailor,
and they
went rather fancy with it.

text_block_list.name: Visiting Children
text_block_list.text:
Run as fast as you can, please!
Good
luck out there!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, goodness, I've kept you all waiting,
haven't I?
Well, please take a good
look.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I think you'll understand the feelings we
hold in
our hearts as we race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute walks over to the track
with poise
and grace. In that moment,
she looks more
dependable than ever.
